conventions: A book manuscript in Markdown. Each piece is a file in manuscript/front/, manuscript/chapters/ or manuscript/back/ with a front matter block (title, status, drafted_by, optional part); book.json holds the title, author, publishing details and the reading order, and the title page, copyright page and contents are built from it. Notes the book needs are in notes/. The reader app is in src/; the book's typography is the variables at the top of src/styles.css.
